def test_search_users_ok():
    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "ad"})
    assert status == 200
    assert data == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}

    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "example"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 2

    assert handle_search_users({"q": ""})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "  "})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123})[0] == 400
"}
